preregistration.operator: Codex operator under explicit user approval in the current task

study.research_question: On the same 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, semantic fixture state, verifier, GPT-5.4/high subscription route, and common timed action surface, how do GEODE and Codex differ in verifier accuracy?
study.research_gap: The prior 30-task observation used different timeout start boundaries and its fixture receipt did not bind score-bearing file mtimes or empty directories.
study.hypothesis: Across the frozen 30-task workload, GEODE verifier accuracy is no more than 10 percentage points below Codex verifier accuracy.
study.decision_rule: supported if the GEODE-minus-Codex verifier-pass-rate delta is at least -0.10; not-supported if lower
study.invalidation_rule: Invalidate the run if any arm changes the frozen deadline, model, route, tool schema, task, semantic fixture, verifier, reset identity, or the GEODE 25K tool-result cap; fails fixture cleanup; lacks native result, verifier, deadline, or trajectory evidence; or exits on an unrecovered provider quota or transport error.
study.analysis_plan: Select all 60 fresh arms only when all 30 pairs are infrastructure-valid; compute (GEODE passes - Codex passes) / 30; report arm accuracy, paired wins, losses, ties, cache-excluded input, output, reasoning, wall time, MCP calls and errors, repeated reads, and termination classes; preserve invalid attempts and do not replace or score them.

environment.reset_strategy: Each native process copies the pinned category fixture to a unique PID-scoped backup; the runner rejects backup residue and verifies the score-bearing semantic fixture before and after every arm. Arms and tasks run serially with no resumed output.

privacy.redaction_boundary: Keep raw prompts, model messages, tool arguments and results, local paths, account identity, OAuth material, and other secrets local; publish only reviewed digest projections, native outcomes, verifier receipts, and redacted trajectories.
